name: hermesdocs-monorepo
description: HermesDocs: Local-first cryptographically verifiable collaborative Markdown editor

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@hermes/crypto && npm run build --workspace=@hermes/core && npm run build --workspace=@hermes/protocol && npm run build --workspace=@hermes/storage && npm run build --workspace=@hermes/sync
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@hermes/verifier && npm run build --workspace=@hermes/signal && npm run build --workspace=@hermes/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
